purpose: Teach: 見せつけ/混じり/ふやす/腰掛け/役立た/焼か/溶かし/襲い

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが家族愛を見せつけるみたいに優しいわね
lines.en: Sho, your dad is so kind to you — the way he shows his love for the family.
lines.style: Warm observation, slightly amused. Soft, affectionate tone. Noticing Sho carefully. A gentle comment that makes space for him to feel seen.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんの言葉に笑顔混じりに頷いたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, when Dad said that, I smiled and nodded.
lines.style: Bright, earnest delivery. Small boy pride in the memory. Quick pace, like he's eager to share something good. Genuine smile underneath the words.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お友達をふやす努力もしてみてね
lines.en: Sho, try making an effort to make some new friends, okay?
lines.style: Gentle suggestion, not a command. Warm but grounded. Slight pause before the request — careful not to sound like she's dismissing what he already has.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとベンチに腰掛けてお話したよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I sat on a bench with Dad and we talked together.
lines.style: Quiet contentment in the delivery. Small voice, unhurried. The satisfaction of a simple, good moment. Natural, matter-of-fact but with warmth underneath.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんが役立たないって思う事は無いわよ
lines.en: Sho, I don't think Mei-sis is useless at all.
lines.style: Tender reassurance, slightly firm. Direct eye-contact level. Quiet but clear conviction. The tone of someone defending without needing to raise her voice.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとさつまいもを焼かれるのを楽しみにしてるよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I'm looking forward to roasting sweet potatoes with Dad.
lines.style: Anticipation brightening the voice. Small, genuine excitement. Unguarded. The tone of a child who trusts the good thing is coming.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがアイスを溶かしてシェイクを作って下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad will melt ice cream and make shakes for you.
lines.style: Soft, quiet pleasure in sharing this. Reflective — gently noticing the abundance of small kindnesses. Unhurried pacing. A tender statement of fact.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、台風が襲い来てもお父さんと一緒なら大丈夫だよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, even if a typhoon comes, I'm okay because I'm with Dad.
lines.style: Calm, steady certainty. No doubt in the voice. Deep trust. Quiet strength — not boastful, just the simple truth of feeling safe. Closing warmth.
